messages:
Rina H.: quick spike from user interviews — several org admins missed the invoice download when they toggled project scope. they expected a persistent download affordance in the header.

Josh K.: agree. current header is getting tall when we show scope + timeframe + actions. suggestion: compress scope into a compact segmented control and surface a subtle primary CTA for invoices.

Elaine (Design): uploaded 3 variants: https://redwood.design/mockups/spend-header-variants
Variant 1: compact segmented scope + inline CTA
Variant 2: scope in top-left, CTA in right rail
Variant 3: single-line header with kebab for overflow and a small download icon button.

Marco: Variant 3 is nice on desktop but worried about discoverability on mobile. maybe combine with a persistent micro-CTA (icon + label) that stays visible when scrolling.

Samir: accessibility note: icon-only CTA loses meaning for screen-reader users. if we go icon-only, ensure aria-label includes scope and timeframe. prefer "Download invoice (Org: Acme Corp)".

Elaine (Design): updated mock: added tooltip and visually-hidden text for screen readers. also proposed a compact token breakdown under the header: show three numeric rows (total cost, token count, avg per call) with a chevron to expand to full chart.

Rina H.: users liked the compact metrics idea in tests — gives quick signal without overwhelming. they also asked for a CSV export for line items next to invoice download.

Josh K.: product ok with CSV export, but we should clarify naming: "Download invoices (PDF)" vs "Export usage (CSV)". track both clicks.

Marco: UX nit: when switching scope between org/project, the top-line totals should animate to avoid jarring jumps. also preserve query params so deep links to a project include timeframe and scope.

Samir: telemetry required: invoice_download, csv_export, scope_change, header_cta_click. ensure invoice filename format is stable: <org>_<project?>_YYYY-MM.csv or .pdf.

ux-bot: attachment: accessibility-checklist.md linked (uploaded)

Elaine (Design): I'll push updated frames with hover/focus states and the compact metrics. tagging @eng-frontend for feasibility.

Josh K.: I'll open a small RFC for the header compression and CSV endpoint; aim for prototype next week.

Rina H.: thanks — let's aim to test Variant 3 + compact metrics in the next round of interviews. closing thread after PRs linked.
